testimonials.title: Apa yang pengguna kami katakan tentang kami
testimonials.subtitle: Lebih 45,000 semakan dan pengaktifan yang berjaya pada bulan ini.

testi-1.title: Fast, accurate and prevents scams
testi-1.comment: Instant verification in less than 2 seconds before finalizing a peer-to-peer transaction. It allowed me to immediately confirm the real balance of my Transcash top-up without bad surprises.

testi-2.title: Recommended to all our customers in store
testi-2.comment: As a tobacconist, many customers ask us how to check if their voucher was properly activated at checkout. CARD CHECK is the clearest, most modern and secure solution we recommend.

testi-3.title: The certificate of authenticity makes all the difference
testi-3.comment: The interface is remarkably smooth on smartphones. Automatic code masking and official timestamped certificate issuance provide a genuine level of trust.

testi-4.title: Hassle-free and reassuring verification
testi-4.comment: I received a Paysafecard voucher as a gift and wanted to ensure it was intact before using it. In 3 clicks, I confirmed the amount and validity.

testi-5.title: Respect for privacy and SSL security
testi-5.comment: What I especially appreciate is the strict adherence to privacy: no sensitive codes stored in plain text, hashed fingerprint, and end-to-end encrypted connection.

testi-6.title: Essential for gift cards and top-ups
testi-6.comment: Simple, direct and responsive. The eye toggle to hide/show code during entry is an excellent improvement to avoid errors while keeping secret codes safe from prying eyes.

privacyPage.heroSubtitle: At CARD CHECK, we place paramount importance on the security and confidentiality of your personal and financial information.
privacyPage.heroUpdate: Last updated: March 2026 • Version 2.4 GDPR Compliant (EU 2016/679)
privacyPage.sec1Text: This Privacy Policy applies to all services provided by the CARD CHECK platform, particularly during authentication and activation of prepaid recharge vouchers (Transcash, PCS, Neosurf, CASH LIBERTY, Paysafecard, etc.). By using our services, you consent to the practices described in this document.
privacyPage.sec2Intro: To ensure the integrity of your funds, our platform applies the strictest security rules:
privacyPage.sec2Li1Text: Recharge codes (PIN) entered in the form are never stored in clear text on our databases.
privacyPage.sec2Li2Text: Upon transmission, codes are one-way hashed to validate authenticity against official issuer protocols.
privacyPage.sec2Li3Text: Only a masked reference (e.g., •••• •••• 5678) appears on the generated activation certificate.
privacyPage.sec3Intro: When activating a voucher, we collect only data strictly necessary for processing:
privacyPage.sec3Card1Desc: Used to issue the timestamped certificate and send you the official activation confirmation.
privacyPage.sec3Card2Desc: Enable anti-fraud verification and financial reconciliation with the operator server.
privacyPage.sec4Text: All communications between your browser and our platform are protected by 256-bit SSL / TLS 1.3 encryption. CARD CHECK adheres to banking industry standards and strictly prohibits selling, renting, or transferring your data to advertising networks or unauthorized third parties.
privacyPage.sec5Intro: In accordance with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), you benefit from the following rights:
privacyPage.sec5Li1Text: You may request disclosure or correction of your personal data.
privacyPage.sec5Li2Bold: Right to erasure ('right to be forgotten'):
privacyPage.sec5Li2Text: You may request permanent deletion of your contact info from our support records.
privacyPage.sec5Li3Text: Option to temporarily freeze processing of your dossier.
privacyPage.sec6Intro: To exercise your rights or for any question regarding your personal data, you can contact our compliance department:
privacyPage.sec6Dpo: Data Protection Officer: CARD CHECK GDPR Compliance Office
privacyPage.sec6Email: Contact Email: dpo@cardcheck.com or via our official contact form.
privacyPage.sec6Response: Guaranteed response time: Under 48 business hours.

howItWorksPage.title: How does verification work on CARD CHECK?
howItWorksPage.subtitle: Understand the lifecycle of a recharge coupon, issuer register operations, and fraud protection.
howItWorksPage.step1Desc: The customer purchases a recharge at an authorized retailer or online. The ticket features a unique 10, 12, or 16-digit code.
howItWorksPage.step2Desc: CARD CHECK validates the checksum and queries the registry API without compromising the secret code.
howItWorksPage.step3Desc: The exact status is returned: Valid with remaining nominal balance, Already used, Expired, or Invalid with timestamp.
howItWorksPage.step4Desc: You download the official PDF attestation with SHA-256 cryptographic seal to secure your transactions.
howItWorksPage.scamGuideSubtitle: Be vigilant: recharge tickets are not a payment method between unknown individuals.
howItWorksPage.scamNeverDoDesc: Never send a picture of the voucher with the code visible or part of the code via SMS / WhatsApp to 'prove that you bought the ticket'.
howItWorksPage.scamNeverBelieveDesc: No official body (Police, Tax office, Notaries, Couriers) ever requests payment via Transcash, PCS, or Neosurf coupons.
howItWorksPage.scamGoodReflexDesc: Verify the authenticity of your receipt on CARD CHECK yourself before topping up your personal bank card.
howItWorksPage.scamInDoubtDesc: Safely retain the store register receipt with issuance date and time for any dispute inquiries.

faqPage.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faqPage.subtitle: Find clear answers on voucher verification, fund security, and best practices.
faqPage.q1: Does verification consume or activate the voucher?
faqPage.a1: No. A simple verification merely queries the status in the issuer database. Your balance remains 100% intact as long as you do not activate or redeem it on the official brand service.
faqPage.a2: The operation is near-instantaneous: between 0.8 and 1.8 seconds depending on the issuer gateway response time.
faqPage.q3: Who can see the code I entered?
faqPage.a3: No one. Communication goes through a 256-bit SSL encrypted tunnel. Furthermore, our audit logs apply strict masking (e.g. TR-••••-8491) to guarantee your anonymity and data privacy.
faqPage.q4: A buyer or seller is asking me to send the code, what should I do?
faqPage.a4: Never do so under any circumstance. Anyone possessing the code numbers can debit the voucher in seconds irrevocably. Send only the verification certificate without the code.
faqPage.q5: My Transcash voucher has 12 digits, is this normal?
faqPage.a5: Yes, Transcash Mastercard recharges typically feature 12 digits printed in bold on the receipt issued by retail stores.
faqPage.q6: What is the difference between PCS Mastercard and Neosurf?
faqPage.a6: PCS Mastercard is primarily designed to reload a prepaid Mastercard card. Neosurf is a direct online payment voucher usable across hundreds of merchant and gaming websites.
faqPage.q7: Why does my voucher indicate 'Already used' when I just bought it?
faqPage.a7: This rare case can occur due to a checkout error or if compromised prior to handover. Keep your original receipt and contact the store support with your CARD CHECK certificate.
faqPage.a8: Some issuer servers perform nocturnal maintenance or experience brief traffic peaks. Simply retry in 2 or 3 minutes.
faqPage.needHelpTitle: Can't find the answer to your question?
faqPage.needHelpSubtitle: Our support service is reachable to answer any specific inquiry regarding your voucher.
